name: olimpo
description: The IMO corpus with guided solving: historic olympiad problems with statement, hint ladder, key idea and full solutions — retrieved on demand, disclosed progressively. Built to make small local models (Qwen 27B/30B class) genuinely good at olympiad math: the corpus carries the ground truth, the model carries the reasoning, and numeric answers are checked deterministically.

olimpo.description: IMO practice and explanation with hint ladder, deterministic answer checks and full classic solutions

interface.shortDescription: Olympiad math your small model can actually teach.
interface.longDescription: A curated corpus of historic IMO problems (the 1959 opener, the legendary 1988-6 Vieta jumping, Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv, Sophie Germain, EGZ…) with statement, hint ladder, key idea and full solutions — honestly labeled full vs sketch. The architecture is the point: retrieval over recall for small local models (the corpus carries the ground truth, the model explains it), progressive disclosure (statement → hint1 → hints → keyIdea → solution; solutions never leak early), deterministic answer checking for numeric problems (no trusting model arithmetic), a local progress ledger, deterministic study plans, and an ingest tool so the corpus grows with your own problems. Technique-based lessons come free: search by tag (vieta-jumping, invariants, sophie-germain) and the family assembles itself. Fully offline.
